climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Veneto DOCG in the hills of Treviso province, between Vittorio Veneto and Valdobbiadene. Its wine is made from Glera, with Verdiso, Perera and Bianchetta Trevigiana allowed, in sparkling and still styles. Cartizze lies inside.
